messages.subject: Locked out after password change
messages.body: Hi IT, I changed my password this morning and now Outlook keeps asking for credentials and then locks me out. Can you unlock my account? I'm on the 3rd floor if you need the laptop. Thanks, Priya

messages.subject: 🖨️ Printer fleet maintenance window 🔧
messages.body:
Hello 👋 Service Desk,

Scheduled maintenance for the 4th-floor printer fleet runs Thursday 18:00–20:00. Expect brief outages.

messages.subject: Is this email a phishing attempt?
messages.body: Hey, I got an email that told me to wire money to a new supplier account and to keep it secret from finance. It felt off, so I didn't click anything. Should I forward it to security? — Marco
